production.note: US model years. First: MBUSA's launch release is titled 'The new 2018 Mercedes-AMG E63 S Sedan' and says 'US dealer launch is planned in the summer of 2017' (mbusa-e63-s-launch-2016); MBUSA published 2018, 2019, 2020 and 2021 E 63 S Sedan specification pages. Only the S was covered by MBUSA's US launch release and specification pages; the non-S E 63 is not mentioned. Last: Carvana's 2023 guide says 'The biggest change for the 2023 Mercedes-AMG E-Class is the return of the E 63 S sedan and wagon after sitting out 2022. Otherwise, this final year of the fifth-generation AMG E-Class is largely unchanged.' (carvana-2023-amg-e-class). No 2022 model year E 63 S was sold in the US.

body.note: 'Four-door, five passenger sedan'. The E 63 S Wagon (S213) was sold alongside it: 'Four-door, five-passenger wagon' (mbusa-2018-e63-s-wagon-specs).

aspiration.note: 'Two twin-scroll turbochargers are deployed for the first time'

fuel.note: Inferred from the sheet's description of the V8 biturbo petrol engine.

drivetrain.note: 'AMG Performance 4MATIC+ permanent all-wheel drive with variable torque distribution and drift mode'

transmission.note: 'Transmission Type | AMG SPEEDSHIFT MCT 9-Speed': a nine-speed planetary automatic with a wet start-up clutch in place of the torque converter.

powerHp.note: Quote: "Horsepower @ rpm | 603 @ 5,750 – 6,500". MBUSA's 2019, 2020 and 2021 sedan sheets give the same 603 @ 5,750 – 6,500 (mbusa-2019-e63-s-sedan-specs, mbusa-2020-e63-s-sedan-specs, mbusa-2021-e63-s-sedan-specs).

weightLb.note: US curb weight, sedan with the only transmission, 2018 model. Quote: "Curb Weight (lbs) | 4,515". The 2019 sheet reads "4,515 lbs est.", the 2020 sheet "TBA" and the 2021 (facelift) sheet "4,497". The wagon is 4,669 lb on the 2018 wagon sheet (mbusa-2018-e63-s-wagon-specs). MBUSA's 2018 sheet prints 4,515 without a qualifier; its 2019 sheet prints the same number as an estimate.

sources.title: The new 2018 Mercedes-AMG E63 S Sedan
2023 Mercedes-Benz AMG E-Class: What's New, Specs & Features

discrepancies.reason: Model year. Both are MBUSA curb weights for the sedan: 4,515 lb on the 2018 sheet, 4,497 lb on the 2021 (facelift) sheet.
discrepancies.resolution: Used 4,515 lb because the reference model year is 2018.

reviewNotes: The last model year (2023) and the absence of a 2022 model year rest on an unsigned Carvana guide page; no MBUSA page for the 2022 or 2023 E 63 S could be opened (MBUSA's own 2018-2021 specification pages were opened). Also decide whether the wagon should stay in this record's body list: the guide says to list every body of a variant, and the E 63 S Wagon is the same variant.
